data_basis: Multi-vintage blend, built 2026-08-13 (rebuild_cdm_v3.py). 2022 UN Comtrade authenticated bilateral pull is the floor (broadest country coverage, ~57 importers incl. UAE/South Africa/Vietnam and ~20 others absent from the 2024 pull). 2024 UN Comtrade authenticated bilateral pull, plus real primary-source overlays (Eurostat NRG_TI_OIL for 11 EU crude importers, UK DESNZ ET 3.14, US EIA PET_IMPORTS), override the 2022 figure wherever a newer bilateral figure exists for the same importer+exporter+commodity pair. Every row in this file carries its own source_id/source_label/data_year; see CDM-DATA-VINTAGE.md for the full writeup, including the known China crude country-of-origin attribution caveat.
coverage_note: 91 importing nations, 14 chokepoints, 17 commodities. CDM v2: Capesize iron ore/coal rerouted via Cape of Good Hope (LOMBOK). OMN LNG Hormuz transit removed. West Africa corridor split Atlantic vs Mediterranean.

Total China chokepoint exposure is retained as directionally reliable (externally corroborated, see CDM-DATA-VINTAGE.md); per-exporter breakdown should be treated as indicative, not verified.
